UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores a player's non-PII companion state, evolution XP, vitals, currency, and unlocked pet species.

uid.description: The owner user ID matching request.auth.uid.

username.description: Display handle chosen by the user.

activeSpeciesId.description: Currently active companion species ID across Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic tiers.

activePetName.description: Custom nickname given to the active companion using the pencil rename control.

unlockedSpecies.description: Bounded list of unlocked species IDs (maximum 50 species).

petXp.description: Total evolution experience points driving Baby, Kid, Teen, and Adult stages.

petEnergy.description: Companion vitality and nourishment meter from 0 to 100.

gold.description: Earned currency spent in the Pet Sanctuary Store.

cheatCount.description: Cumulative count of anti-cheat penalties triggered by premature task completion.

totalTasksCompleted.description: Cumulative count of verified tasks completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: A user to-do task linked to companion growth milestones and anti-cheat timer validation.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this task.

category.description: Task category linked to pet care attributes.

difficulty.description: Task difficulty tier determining XP, Gold, and anti-cheat minimum incubation time.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the task. Once completed or penalized, terminal state locking prevents further updates.

minDurationSeconds.description: Minimum required elapsed seconds before completion to prevent instant-check cheating.

xpReward.description: Evolution XP granted on legitimate completion.

goldReward.description: Gold coins granted on legitimate completion.

createdAtMs.description: Client creation epoch milliseconds used alongside server timestamps for countdown display.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last task update.

/users/{userId}.description: Player profile and companion state document indexed by auth UID.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Subcollection of to-do tasks belonging to a specific user.
